record.description_evidence:
VideoGen: AI Video Generator. Transform text into cinematic videos with synced AI soundtracks. Extend your clips seamlessly while maintaining consistent motion. Create high-fidelity images in seconds.
[ Features]
- AI Video with Audio: Generate videos with integrated AI music and SFX that match the movement.
- AI Video Extender: Expand your short clips into longer stories with temporal consistency.
- AI Image Creator: Turn prompts into stunning art, from realism to anime styles.
[Premium Membership] 
Unlock professional tools by becoming a Premium member:
- Priority rendering for AI videos and audio-syncing.
- Access to the advanced Video Extension engine.
- Advanced photo generation.
[Auto-Renewal Terms]
- Payment: Charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Renewal: Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Management: You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID Account Settings.
[Support & Legal] 
We appreciate your feedback! 
Contact email: videogenhelp@gmail.com
Terms of Service: https://vgen.nablaai.cn/public/global/agreement/Terms%20of%20Service.html
Privacy Policy: https://vgen.nablaai.cn/public/global/agreement/Privacy%20Policy.html
